plainTranslation: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant sit right on top of your direction, ambitions, and public reputation.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
summaryShort: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant sit right on top of your direction, ambitions, and public reputation.
summaryDeep: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant sit right on top of your direction, ambitions, and public reputation. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
